history.prompt:
Create an original publication-quality technical explanatory illustration as a no-text PNG. The supplied external images are mechanism references only: independently design a fresh composition, never imitate their layout or typography. Use a pure white canvas (transparent is acceptable only if it composites as pure white), thin muted graphite flow arrows, flat 2D orthographic shapes, smooth solid pale fills. Palette: cyan input (#4DBBD5), green processing (#00A087), warm orange pooling (#F39B7F), muted blue representations (#3C5488), red output/gradients (#E64B35), neutral gray supporting parts. Colors at low opacity for large areas, stronger outlines and small accents. Balance white modules with selectively pale colored groups, one dominant color per semantic group. Same semantic modules share treatment; adjacent unlike semantics have different color. No glossy icon tiles, no card dashboard, no thick title bars, no decorative 3D, no perspective side faces, no extruded tensors, no shadow, glow, blur, gradient, texture, paper grain, noise, ripple, stripe or watermark. Mechanism marks (flat grids, feature-map thumbnails, small nodes, pooling cells) must carry scientific information rather than decorative icons. Optional decorative icons at most one per group; preferably none for operator diagrams. Avoid excessive boxes around everything. Reserve generous blank title and adjacent numeric annotation areas for later real-font typesetting. ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, letters, digits, equations, operation symbols, pseudo-glyphs, placeholder scribbles or watermark. All labels and math will be added later. A handwritten specimen inside an input image is an allowed visual sample, not a printed label. Arrowheads are required at actual destinations, no disconnected stubs or unexplained edges.

Scientific brief:
Explain dense multichannel 2D convolution with THREE input channel maps and TWO output channels. Draw three flat input grids as aligned color-tinted square maps, two separate output branches, each branch has its own filter composed of THREE aligned tiny kernel slices; each slice is paired with one input channel. Highlight the same spatial local window on the three input grids, show three dot-products being summed with one bias into a highlighted scalar cell in its output map. Each of the TWO output channels independently uses ALL THREE input channels; no serial path between output maps. Represent six filter slices unambiguously as two triplets, no extra channel maps. Reserve title spaces for input/kernel/output and under-branch annotation spaces, clear graphics richer than just rectangular process cards.

Revise THIS new multichannel convolution draft. Critical fix: THREE different input grids each go to its OWN corresponding kernel slice in EACH of the two output branches. Currently inputs are merged by a shared bus before the six kernels, misleadingly mixing channels. REMOVE this merging bus completely. Connect input1 to the top kernel in upper triplet and top kernel in lower triplet; input2 to the middle kernel of both triplets; input3 to the bottom kernel of both triplets. SIX independent channel-to-kernel paths, may route distinct pale cyan thin curves to avoid crossings; never merge different channels before the per-channel dot products. Keep THREE input maps, SIX kernel slices arranged as two triplets, per-channel partial result maps and TWO summed output maps with one bias each. Sum occurs only after each triplet of per-channel products. Remove existing plus/dot glyphs inside operator circles, leave them empty for later font overlay. No letters/numbers/math/pseudotext. Pure white flat2D with pale smooth solid fills.

Each row shows three input maps paired with three different kernel slices; three local dot products are then summed with one bias into ONE output map. Make three channel-pairs clearly separated: each small input-window grid AND matching filter grid have their own two-input product operator, their partial product values enter a single sum at the right. No shared bus that mixes different input channels before products. Top row uses output filter1's three slices; lower row uses output filter2's three slices. source_audit.caption: 三输入、两输出通道的卷积。左侧三张错位叠放的平面共同组成输入张量$\bm X$，蓝、紫、青区分输入通道；每个输出核的同色切片读取相应通道中高亮的局部窗口。各切片完成局部乘加后，三项贡献与偏置一起求和，分别写入右侧输出张量$\bm Z$的两个通道；紫、青输出平面分别由核1、核2产生。示意采用$4\times4$输入、$2\times2$核、步长一和无填充，输出为$3\times3$；核在空间位置间共享。

source_audit.mechanism_brief: 三张平面输入通道，两个输出核各有三个对应输入通道切片，突出同一空间位置的局部窗口。每个输出把三通道切片乘加结果与本输出偏置相加，写入一个输出通道；核1、核2各产生一张输出。
must_preserve: 每个密集输出核都读取全部输入通道
两个输出不得串联，平面叠片只表示通道而非装饰3D。
source_audit.layout_instruction: 模型自主构图，只使用本简报中的事实与新选外部同主题参考；禁止任何本项目旧图、旧预览、裁图作为图像输入。
source_audit.original_export_instruction: 优先按label从当前target单卷PDF裁图；仅同名png不得默认等于当前正文。无单独栅格时可编译当前原TikZ源作对比，禁止传入模型。
